results.description:
Embrace the freedom of being a street racer in the dynamic open world of CarX Street. Accept the challenge and become the legend of Sunset City. Realistic races on highways and city streets, plus top-speed drift races from the makers of CarX Drift Racing 2.
Build the car of your dreams using part tuning that unlocks all the physics of CarX Technology car behavior.
 
Explore every corner - the enormous world of CarX Street and the exciting car races will leave you exhilarated! Conquer clubs, hit top speed, and drift!
 
WARNING! You may spend hours playing this game. Make sure to take a break every 40 minutes.
 
GAME FEATURES
 
CAREER
- Drive at top speed or drift through turns. The choice is yours!
- Join clubs, defeat bosses, and prove to everyone that you're the best driver in this city!
- Pick out parts for your vehicle and unlock 100% of its potential!
- Buy houses for your cars and assemble collections for every race mode.
- Fuel up with the right gas for the next race at city gas stations.
- Dynamic day/night change. Get behind the wheel at any time of night or day.
 
REAL-TIME MULTIPLAYER
- Compete with real people in online battles.
- Be first and win all the races in Sunset City.
- Drift down narrow streets or speed highways and discover new performance edges of your car.

IMPROVED CAR TUNING
- A detailed car-building system.
- Swap parts and trick out your car for a specific race.
- Upgrade the engine, transmission, body, suspension, and tires.
- Swap the engine of your unique car.
 
VISUAL CAR TUNING
- Customize the mirrors, headlights, lights, skirt, bumper, rims, and much more!
- Create a unique look for your car!
 
THE MOST REALISTIC MOBILE RACING GAME
- Check out the impressive physics and controls that make you the master of your car.
- Admire the modern, high-quality graphics and enormous open world.

PREMIUM SUBSCRIPTION:
Users with a Premium Account get a range of bonuses and unique privileges:
- 10,000 silver every day
- 2 gold every day
- 3 sets of tires every day
- 50% off on teleporting anywhere in Sunset City
- x2 rewards in Single Races, Delivery quests, and collected Gift Boxes
- -30% time on the timer in Elite Races and Delivery quests
- Free creation of online rooms
- Unique nickname frame in online mode and in profile window
- Unlimited attempts in Elite Races and leaderboards
- Removes level restrictions on cars and parts
Get your Premium Subscription for 7 days, 1 month, 3 months, 6 months. You can cancel auto renewal of your subscription by going to your iTunes account not later than 24 hours before the next billing period.
Your Premium Subscription will be renewed within 24 hours upon expiration of the current Premium Subscription.

Support service
If you find any bugs in the game, please contact our support service.
Email: support@carx-tech.com
 
DEVICE REQUIREMENTS
This app requires a device with at least 3 GB of memory. You must be connected to the internet for stable gameplay!
